text: Radar list is fixed. The Landing screen lives in screens/Landing.tsx, so look for its band CSS and any overflow: visible rules in the canvas src css outside ops/insights.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src && ls screens | head -40; find . -name node_modules -prune -o -name '*.css' -print | xargs grep -nE 'overflow(-[xy])?: *(visible|unset|initial)|band' | grep -v '^./ops/' | cut -c1-300 | head -30
